title: Letter to Editor, 5 December 1835
source_note: JS, Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to the editor of Latter Day Saints’ Messenger and Advocate [John Whitmer], Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, 5 Dec. 1835. Featured version published in “To the Editor of the Messenger and Advocate,” Latter Day Saints’ Messenger and Advocate, Dec. 1835, 2:240. For more complete source information, see the source note for Letter to Oliver Cowdery, Dec. 1834.
